title: lathyrus nivalis subsp. atropatanus
intro: Lathyrus nivalis subsp. atropatanus, commonly known as Atropatan vetch, is a sub-species of the Lathyrus nivalis plant, belonging to the Fabaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of various ailments. The bioactive constituents present in Atropatan vetch include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, contributing to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. Additionally, its therapeutic actions include wound healing, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer properties, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
